description: This Java source file defines a utility class 'JsonExamplesProducer' that generates example JSON files for testing or documentation purposes. It creates various JSON representations related to search models, commands, responses, and errors within the Eclipse Ditto framework, primarily for testing or illustrative purposes.

classes.name: JsonExamplesProducer
classes.description: A utility class that produces sample JSON files representing search models, commands, responses, and errors for the Eclipse Ditto framework.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point of the program, processes command-line arguments and initiates JSON file generation.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Validates arguments and calls produce with the target directory.

methods.name: produce
methods.description: Calls specific methods to generate different categories of JSON files (model, commands, responses, errors).

methods.name: produceSearchModel
methods.description: Creates example search model JSON files, including a sample search result with two 'Thing' objects.

methods.name: produceSearchCommands
methods.description: Creates search command JSON files, including a query and a count command.

methods.name: produceSearchCommandResponses
methods.description: Creates JSON files with responses to search commands, including search results and error responses.

methods.name: produceSearchExceptions
methods.description: Creates example JSON files representing possible exceptions during search operations.

methods.name: writeJson
methods.description: Serializes a Jsonifiable object to a JSON string and writes it to the specified file path.
